Version 0.7.0 of collections removes Option, Some, None, Ok, Err and Result, and 0.10.0 removes 83 more names. @procedures/collections exports these names from its root. Thus the update is a breaking change of the client group, and it ships as its own MINOR after a release that marks the names deprecated.
